base_topic_help: Must match the device topic base configured on the panel. Unique per panel.
ha_prefix_help: Topic prefix the panel listens on for entity state. Same on every panel.
broker_connected: Connected to the MQTT broker at %s.
broker_failed: No connection to the MQTT broker at %s: %s
broker_timeout: The MQTT broker at %s did not answer within 10 seconds.
broker_invalid_port: The port must be a whole number from 1 to 65535.
devices_info: Nothing reaches the panels until you click Refresh detected devices and save; until then each panel keeps the layout it has, whatever an earlier version left. Saving after Refresh publishes every ticked row, every row under Manual entities and every meter on the Energy tab, even with nothing ticked; each panel then removes its tiles for everything else. Export each panel's tile layout first if you want to keep it.
refresh_result: %s devices detected, %s of them new. Tick Show on panels for each device the panels should get, then save. Saving also publishes every row under Manual entities and every meter on the Energy tab.
manual_info: States no detection reaches, such as a helper in 0_userdata.0. Every row here is shown on the panels. The name is optional; the kind matters only for a date/time state that holds no value yet.
preview_not_detected: The adapter did not detect this device at its last start: the device is gone, or new since then. A new one can be previewed once the settings are saved, which restarts the adapter.
preview_no_entity: No tile can be made of this device as the type chosen: it has %s. Choose Auto or another type.
preview_degraded: Options dropped: with them, the payload would exceed the panel's limit, so the panel shows this value read-only.
preview_no_state: A scene publishes no state: the panel only triggers it.
lack_climate_channels: no setpoint, temperature, humidity or mode
lack_value_channel: no value to show or set
pair_info: A panel with no broker credentials cannot announce itself over MQTT. Enter its IP address or hostname below to send it the broker credentials saved on the Connection tab and restart it. Panels that already announced themselves can be re-paired from their control.pair button.
pair_host_help: IP address or hostname of the panel, such as 192.168.1.50
pair_done: Credentials sent to the panel at %s. It restarts now and then connects to the broker.
pair_invalid_host: Enter the panel's IP address or hostname, such as 192.168.1.50, with no path.
pair_unreachable: The panel at %s did not answer. Check the address and that the panel is on.
pair_credentials_rejected: The panel at %s refused the credentials (HTTP %s).
pair_restart_unreachable: The panel at %s took the credentials but did not answer the restart. Restart it by hand.
pair_restart_failed: The panel at %s took the credentials but refused the restart (HTTP %s). Restart it by hand.
history_instance_help: The history, SQL or InfluxDB instance the panels read graphs and timelines from. With none chosen, the system's default history instance is used, if one is set.
energy_info: Cumulative meters that only grow, such as a kWh or m³ total; never a counter that resets daily, such as energy today or a daily yield: its week and month would be wrong. Energy tiles show each meter's consumption today by the hour, and over the week and the month by the day, from the history instance on the Advanced tab. Enable logging for each meter there. An export meter, such as grid feed-in, counts negative. Solar and battery discharge count as import; battery charging, like grid feed-in, as export. A price adds a cost entry in the currency below; a category with two or more meters also gets its total. On a panel, pick the meters as energy.<name>. Like devices, meters reach the panels only once Refresh detected devices on the Devices tab has been clicked and saved; from then on they are published even with no device ticked, and each panel removes its tiles for everything else. Export each panel's tile layout first if you want to keep it.
currency_help: The unit of the prices above, shown on cost entries.
coalesce_ms_help: Bursts inside this window publish once. The final value is always delivered.
max_publish_queue_help: When the queue is full the oldest message is dropped.
protocol_trace_help: Verbose per-message logging. Use only while diagnosing.
